Property.name: RecordMapIn
Property.Description: Configuration item(s) to which to send file stream messages

Property.name: recordMapFull
Property.Description: Full classname of the RecordMap - the name may need to be normalized.

Method.name: OnProcessInput
Method.Description: Wrap the input stream object in a StreamContainer message object and send it. If the SyncCall setting is true, send synchronously; otherwise send async to ensure that we don't return to the Adapter and let it delete the stream before the target Config Item is finished processing it.

Method.name: OnInit
Method.Description: This user callback method is called via initConfig() from %OnNew() or in the case of SOAP Services from OnPreSOAP()
